evidence.section: Abstract

evidence.quote: In the LFW process, frictional shear stress played a dominant role at a welding time of 0–0.75 s. At a welding time of 0.75–1.65 s, the friction shear stress decreased, and the extrusion pressure increased. Extrusion pressure then played a leading role at a welding time of 1.65–1.75 s.
